summary: The title band at the top of a public portal page: a dga-breadcrumb trail, the page h1 and an optional subtitle, with slots for an illustration and actions.

inputs.name: title
inputs.description: The page title (translated); rendered as the page's only h1.

inputs.name: breadcrumbs
inputs.description: The trail above the title, current page last; empty shows no breadcrumb.

inputs.name: breadcrumbLabel
inputs.description: Accessible name of the breadcrumb landmark (translated); give it whenever there are breadcrumbs.

slots.description: A decorative image or icon at the end side, shown from the md breakpoint up; mark it aria-hidden or give an empty alt.
Buttons or links under the title.

a11y: One h1 per page; the breadcrumb is a named nav landmark with aria-current=page on the current crumb (needs the Angular router). The illustration is decorative. Logical CSS mirrors in RTL.
